The JAN-31-2003 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE is canceled.
YOU ARE HEREBY NOTIFIED that this case is set for Jury TRIAL on JUL-28-2003 at 9:30 AM in Dept.
206.
A MANDATORY SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE is set for JUL-07-2003 at 4:15 PM in Department 210, 400
MCALLISTER STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94102. Sanctions will be imposed for failure to comply with
Local Rule 5.0.A. and Cal. Rules of Court, Rule 225.
If any party objects to this order, written notice must be served on all parties and filed with the Court and all
counsel must appear for an objection hearing on JAN-31-2003 in Department 212 at 9:00AM.
After JAN-31-2003, ALL CONTINUANCES MUST BE BY NOTICED MOTION, Heard in Department 206, 400
MCALLISTER STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94102, on Tuesday through Friday at 9:30 AM.
STIPULATIONS FOR CONTINUANCES WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED.
DATED: JAN-21-2003 ARLENE T. BORICK
